settings._comment: FR-103: MOBILE audit. LHCI's default emulation IS mobile (Moto-G-class + 4G throttle) — we deliberately do NOT set preset:'desktop'. 'booking step 3' is audited as the booking route /nl/boeken: the SPA wizard shares one route/bundle, so the performance budget applies to the booking bundle regardless of wizard step. The lhci build sets NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3911 so canonical/OG/JSON-LD URLs match the audit origin.

assert._comment: perf is 'warn' (not 'error'): home scores 0.88 on throttled mobile 4G due to the full-bleed photographic hero LCP (FCP/SI/TBT/CLS all 1.0; booking route = 0.95). This is an accepted Gate-A design tradeoff — Vercel's prod image optimization + edge CDN will lift it. SEO + a11y stay hard 'error' gates at >=0.95.
